Offline speech recognition dependencies for MyProject2

Vosk API 0.3.45, Copyright 2020-2021 Alpha Cephei Inc.
Source: https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api/tree/v0.3.45
Windows distribution:
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api/releases/download/v0.3.45/vosk-win64-0.3.45.zip
License: Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-Vosk-Apache-2.0.txt.
The four runtime DLLs are copied unchanged from this official distribution.

English model: vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15
Copyright 2020 Alpha Cephei Inc.
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.zip
The official model catalog lists Apache License 2.0 for this model.
Its README and license are retained under Content/VoiceModels.

The distribution includes GCC runtime libraries libgcc_s_seh-1.dll and
libstdc++-6.dll. GCC is licensed under GPLv3 with the GCC Runtime Library
Exception; copies are included as LICENSE-GCC-GPL-3.0.txt and
LICENSE-GCC-Runtime-Exception.txt.
https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING3
https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING.RUNTIME

The distribution includes the MinGW-w64 winpthreads runtime
libwinpthread-1.dll. Preserve LICENSE-MinGW-w64.txt and
LICENSE-winpthreads.txt with redistributed binaries.
https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/blob/master/COPYING
https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/blob/master/mingw-w64-libraries/winpthreads/COPYING

Static dependencies included by the published Vosk 0.3.45 Windows build recipe:
- Kaldi: LICENSE-Kaldi.txt (Apache 2.0 and retained attribution notices).
- OpenFST: LICENSE-OpenFST.txt (Apache 2.0; Google copyright notice).
- OpenBLAS: LICENSE-OpenBLAS.txt (BSD redistribution conditions).
- CLAPACK: LICENSE-CLAPACK.txt (BSD redistribution conditions).
- libf2c: LICENSE-libf2c.txt (AT&T, Lucent Technologies and Bellcore notice).
- SimpleJSON: LICENSE-SimpleJSON.txt (license declaration retained from
  the JSON header distributed with Vosk 0.3.45).

Build recipe and linkage evidence:
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api/blob/v0.3.45/travis/Dockerfile.win
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api/blob/v0.3.45/src/Makefile
The recipe selects OpenBLAS v0.3.20, CLAPACK v3.2.1, the Kaldi
vosk-android branch, and the OpenFST repository without a pinned revision.
These identify the source license notices retained here. They do not attest
the exact source revisions used to produce the downloaded release binaries.
Kaldi and OpenFST notices are upstream branch snapshots retrieved on
2026-10-16; source URLs, retrieval times and notice hashes are recorded in
ExternalAssets/Voice/provenance.json.

No runtime libraries or speech model files have been modified.
Download URLs, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in
ExternalAssets/Voice/provenance.json in the source project.

Recognition runs locally. The recognizer uses an unrestricted vocabulary
followed by exact normalized aliases and confidence filtering. It does not
upload audio to a speech service, perform speaker identification, or store
microphone recordings. The separate proximity chat transport relays
push-to-talk audio to nearby players.
